description: Reads static HTML only: it does not run JavaScript, so JS-rendered sites (most big retailers) and bot-protected sites fail with ok:false, error needs_js or blocked, and no charge. Paid: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402, charged only when ok is true. Returns the fields described by a JSON Schema (up to 20 properties) from one public page. Without an x402 payment in _meta["x402/payment"] it returns the price and how to pay instead.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the fields to return (max 20 properties)

name: gofetch_extract
title: Extract JSON fields from a public page ($0.01, only on success)
